SDK Operators, eight finite averaged channels and four complete tiny density
programs, and completed five saved-only notebook cells in ordinary Python 3,
version 3.12.14. Independent saved-evidence postflight review also passed.

large. They are retained below and in the saved reference report. The scope
remains

These statuses concern bounded source, compiler, finite-channel and saved-file
checks. They leave continuum, mixing, target-accuracy and physical contracts
uncomputed. The display below reads the saved status rather than inferring
completion from source presence or manifest integrity.

The executed frozen model is an open diagonal Ising chain with
(h_j=1+(j\bmod3)/8), nearest-neighbor ZZ coefficient (1/8), bath
Hamiltonian (-\omega Z_E/2), uniform-site full XX coupling and pulse
(g(t)=0.08e^{-2(t-1)^2}) over duration 2. The GL3 law has analytic nodes
(1\pm\sqrt{3/5},1) and weights (5/18,4/9,5/18).
Thermal mode uses (\beta=1); ground mode uses bath zero.

The case file retains its authored status because it is a frozen specification,
rather than an execution receipt. The saved scheduler records nine seeded
site/frequency/bath choice sequences for one conditional preparation per case.
An averaged channel power and a fixed schedule’s conditional output are
different objects. Recorded choices do not demonstrate an experimental
population of quantum preparations.

Each complete source includes all (n+1) initial resets, an optional X for
each sampled bath one, every forward primitive, K post-round bath resets
and n terminal Z measurements. One unfused step has (4n+1) RZ,
(4n-2) CX and four H gates. Its complete formula is
((8n+3)KL+2n+K+1+x), where x is the number of bath-one choices.
The display below uses saved actual metadata without parsing QASM into gates

Counting P repetitions projects a complete preparation, random-call workload,
reset and readout for every trial. Fresh thermal repetitions with P>1 use
an X-count range from zero to PK; they do not scale one recorded schedule’s x.
The exporter materializes one schedule. Sampling confidence, synthesis,
routing and physical resources remain uncomputed. Ideal Hamiltonian duration
is not physical runtime.

The completed reference checked four n=1/n=2 cases, with at most three joint
qubits. Nine compact SDK Operators agreed with independent diagonal free
factors and analytic XX matrix products. The check reconstructed full
matrix-unit channels, checked eight raw Choi complete-positivity and
trace-preservation diagnostics, and compared four actual tiny density sources
with their conditional references.

The maximum saved compact Operator residual is 5.332170238093881e-15.
The maxima for averaged channels, fourth powers and averaged endpoint states
are 7.884250117626704e-15, 3.1086000605167327e-14 and
2.864376955436136e-14. The maximum conditional final joint/system residual
is 2.7089456695977975e-14. The fixed 1e-10 guard concerns finite consistency,
rather than target accuracy.

The density checks retained the initial resets and the last bath reset.
Only six terminal system measurements were stripped from the four complete
sources, giving 1,948 premeasurement primitive visits. An external all-ones
SDK input tested initialization, and the final joint-state comparison tested
that the bath finished at zero. Analytic Born probabilities were recorded
without shots.

The method and its theorem assumptions are cited in the

. Its local,
commuting Hamiltonian class does not itself prove the paper’s access
normalization, high-temperature or mixing conditions. The saved finite-pulse
outputs retain large target bias despite compiler and channel agreement.

The public packet includes the original standard-library generator,
independent bounded reference, exact case file, environment lock and MIT
license under

. The recorded numerical packages are NumPy 2.5.4
(BSD-3-Clause) and Qiskit 2.6.2 (Apache-2.0), in Python 3.12.14. Saved
provenance belongs to the packet; the code performs no current-kernel
dependency probe.

The successful saved-only replay established notebook usability and file
integrity. It supplies no continuum bridge, detailed-balance result, mixing
or Gibbs/ground accuracy certificate, mechanized proof, total-error
certificate or fault-tolerant estimate.
